description: Test IMAP connection settings without saving them. Pass the full account fields. To test a SAVED account, pass its `id` together with the masked password exactly as get_mail_account returns it (all asterisks) — Paperless then uses the stored password (without `id` it would try the literal asterisks and report a login failure). Note: Paperless 3.2 answers an unreachable server or refused connection with a bare HTTP 500 rather than a message — treat a 500 as 'could not connect'.

id.description: ID of a saved account whose stored password should be used

is_token.description: true when `password` is an OAuth/app token

password.description: IMAP password or OAuth token. Write-only: Paperless returns it masked as all asterisks (at least 10, one per character), and sending any all-asterisks value back leaves the stored password unchanged.

name: test_mail_account
